known_defects.defect: Two of v1's three declared group regions render as 3-column slivers at the right edge, outside their members: evidence/v1/v1-text.txt frame rows 20-25 (borders at cols 69 and 71, caps at row 20/25 cols 69-71) and rows 40-45 (cols 66-68), while their member boxes sit at rows 21-24 cols 22-62 (docker0, virbr0) and rows 41-44 cols 19-61 (homelab host). Cause (read from rataflow/src/lib.rs region_boxes): the sibling band pass gives every region its own column band in block order without considering the rank axis, so the second and third regions start past their own right face and collapse to `max(start + 3)`. Only one region per tb view can render correctly. Renderer not edited (frozen binary).

Region frame corners (rounded corner glyphs) never render: the corner pass requires a blank cell after the border pass already wrote '─'/'│' there (draw_regions + put_region_glyph). Visible in every region: e.g. evidence/v2/v2-text.txt rows 21 and 26 have no corners at cols 8 and 72; evidence/v3/v3-text.txt row 4 has none at cols 15 and 66.
A route crossing the region's top border keeps its arrowhead on the title row, so a '▼' interrupts the title: evidence/v2/v2-text.txt row 21 '──▼uplinks: wired + wifi ─────────▼──────'.

v1's 'virtual nets' and 'homelab host' region titles are invisible because their regions collapsed. v1 was the view whose three-candidate budget was consumed by two renderer-behaviour probes, so it shipped as is rather than relabelled.

The live pane measured 83x51 in this tab, not 77x47. Fit is proven by the pinned dump of each FINAL spec at 77x47 (pinned/vN-77x47.txt, first line 'viewport: 77x47 zoom: 1.00 natural', no overflow banner); the measured size is recorded as-is and never reported as 77x47.

Hop latencies are printed on the hop node labels ('ont ... 4.5 ms'), not as edge labels: four labelled rank gaps would have cost more rows than the 47-row target. The source prose attaches each value to the hop cell ('ONT / Verizon edge 169.254.3.1 (4.5 ms)'); the historical attempt's edge table attaches 4.5 ms to the ont->vzagg edge. The label follows the prose and the off-by-one-hop ambiguity is recorded here rather than silently resolved.
v4's 'bench internet' answers are a node with no relations of its own (an annotation box sitting at the bottom of the wired path). It is honest but not a topology member.

blockers.detail: One tb view cannot show more than one correct bordered region in this frozen build (D1). Recorded as a capability gap; no workaround existed inside the three-candidate budget. The four shipped views therefore declare exactly one region each, except v1 where the budget was already spent when the behaviour was measured.
v1's first two candidates were spent discovering the height arithmetic and the label-slot warning; the region defect was found on the third, so v1 could not be re-specified.
